style.color: =if(if([$Status] == 'Resolved', 1, if([$Status] == 'Closed', 1, 0)) == 1, '#605E5C', if(Number(@currentField) < Number(@now), '#ffffff', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 14400000, '#ffffff', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 86400000, '#323130', '#107C10'))))
style.background-color: =if(if([$Status] == 'Resolved', 1, if([$Status] == 'Closed', 1, 0)) == 1, '#F3F2F1', if(Number(@currentField) < Number(@now), '#A4262C', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 14400000, '#D83B01', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 86400000, '#FFB900', '#E6F2E6'))))
style.box-shadow: =if(if([$Status] == 'Resolved', 1, if([$Status] == 'Closed', 1, 0)) == 1, 'none', if(Number(@currentField) < Number(@now), '0 1px 4px rgba(164,38,44,0.3)', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 14400000, '0 1px 4px rgba(216,59,1,0.3)', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 86400000, '0 1px 4px rgba(255,185,0,0.3)', 'none'))))

attributes.iconName: =if(if([$Status] == 'Resolved', 1, if([$Status] == 'Closed', 1, 0)) == 1, 'SkypeCheck', if(Number(@currentField) < Number(@now), 'AlertSolid', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 14400000, 'Clock', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 86400000, 'Clock', 'Clock'))))

children.txtContent: =if(if([$Status] == 'Resolved', 1, if([$Status] == 'Closed', 1, 0)) == 1, toLocaleDateString(@currentField), if(Number(@currentField) < Number(@now), 'OVERDUE', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 14400000, toLocaleDateString(@currentField) + ' ' + toLocaleTimeString(@currentField), if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 86400000, toLocaleDateString(@currentField) + ' ' + toLocaleTimeString(@currentField), toLocaleDateString(@currentField)))))

style.color: =if(if([$Status] == 'Resolved', 1, if([$Status] == 'Closed', 1, 0)) == 1, '#107C10', if(Number(@currentField) < Number(@now), '#A4262C', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 14400000, '#D83B01', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 86400000, '#CA5010', '#323130'))))

children.txtContent: =if(if([$Status] == 'Resolved', 1, if([$Status] == 'Closed', 1, 0)) == 1, 'Ticket is ' + [$Status], if(@currentField == '', '', if(Number(@currentField) < Number(@now), 'This ticket is past its SLA deadline', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 14400000, 'Due within 4 hours', if(Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 86400000, 'Due within 24 hours', 'On track')))))
